ideaStatement: Add durable, UTC-stamped traces of actions and decision justifications to logs/records, and safe, interruption-proof cleanup of temp files and managed worktrees that never performs destructive actions outside verified temp/managed paths.

decisions.question: What must traces capture?
decisions.answer: Structured, append-only JSONL trace entries recording the actor, action, target, justification, and outcome of steps and decisions, written to durable logs under .agents/logs/ for future review.
decisions.rationale: The brief asks for better traces of actions and justifications for decisions.

decisions.question: What timestamp format and zone?
decisions.answer: All timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC ending in Z, in every log and record.

decisions.question: What may cleanup delete, and what is forbidden?
decisions.answer: Cleanup may remove ONLY managed worktrees (branch wt/<slug> under the managed worktree root) and allowlisted temp dirs (/tmp/csm-*, /tmp/opencode/csm-*). It must never touch the main checkout, unmanaged/detached worktrees, or any non-temp path; it refuses any path that does not match the managed root and logs the refusal.
decisions.rationale: Safety-first: no destructive action outside temp/managed paths.

decisions.question: How is cleanup made robust to interruption?
decisions.answer: A durable registry (.agents/state/temp-registry.json) records every created worktree and temp dir with runId+UTC ts; create writes it and cleanup reads it, so an interrupted session's resources are still discoverable and removable later. Cleanup is idempotent and supports --dry-run.
decisions.rationale: Interruption safety via durable state, not transcript.

decisions.question: How is safety enforced, not just documented?
decisions.answer: Cleanup verifies each target resolves under the managed root and matches the registry and branch pattern; it defaults to dry-run, requires an explicit --apply, and emits a trace entry for every action and refusal. Unverifiable targets are skipped, never guessed.

researchSynthesis: Grounded in the repo's existing durable-record discipline (csm-skill-progress/1, plan/build journals, .agents artifact index) and its worktree hygiene rules (AGENTS.md, docs/worktree-hygiene.md). The design reuses the artifact-index class pattern (as for .agents/decisions/) for .agents/logs/, adds a shared trace-log library, and makes cleanup registry-driven and fail-closed.

phases.title: Structured UTC trace logging
phases.goal: Provide a shared, UTC-stamped, append-only trace/decision log and wire it into the scripts that create/clean resources.

phases.title: Safe, interruption-proof cleanup
phases.goal: Add a cleanup command that removes only managed worktrees and allowlisted temp dirs, safely and idempotently, using a durable registry.
deliverables: safety guards (managed-root check, branch pattern, registry match, never main/foreign)
acceptanceHints: cleanup removes an eligible managed worktree and a /tmp/csm-* dir in a fixture
an ineligible foreign path is refused and logged

phases.title: UTC enforcement, docs, and gates
phases.goal: Enforce UTC timestamps repo-wide, document the traces/cleanup contract, and keep gates green.
